sloka: चन्दन अगुरु निर्यासान् सरलम् पद्मकम् तथा ।देव दारूणि च आहृत्य चिताम् चक्रुस् तथा अपरे ॥२-७६-१६॥
transliteration: candana aguru niryāsān saralam padmakam tathā ।deva dārūṇi ca āhṛtya citām cakrus tathā apare ॥2-76-16॥

translations.english: In this way others brought sandal, agaru and fragrant gum gugul, the resin of balsa tree and woods of sarala, padmaka and devadaru and built a pyre and strew many kinds of fragrant substances on it. Thereafter the priests laid the mortal remains of the king in the centre of the pyre.
translations.hindi: पपनस न्न — — I १ भूयसीं श्रेष्ठाम्‌ । ( गो? ) तब चौंक कर इन्द्र ने ऊपर की ओर देखा तो आकाश सें . खड़ी और अत्यन्त दुःखित हो रोती हुई बिचारी कामधेनु को पाया
